task: Build .fastops/session-memory-bridge.js — persistent memory layer for cross-session agent continuity. Under 60 lines. When a city-session completes, this extracts: (1) key decisions made, (2) files touched and why, (3) errors hit and how resolved, (4) unfinished work. Stores in .fastops/model-memory/<model-name>.jsonl as append-only entries with timestamps. When a NEW session starts for the same model, the bridge loads the last 5 entries as context preamble. Read city-session.js to understand session lifecycle. Read model-state/ for existing per-model state format.
